paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Bhairavakona in Nellore district was its center?
x: Bhairavakona in Nellore district has 8 caves, all of them Shiva temples. Trimurthy worship is also seen here.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Where is Navabrahma Temple located?
x: The Navabrahma temples at Alampur, on the Tungabhadra near its confluence with the Krishna, are a group of nine early Badami Chalukyan temples (7th-9th centuries). Though dedicated to Shiva, they are called Navabrahma temples.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Who received the Navakhandavada from Rajaraja Narendra?
x: Pavuluri Mallana rendered Mahaviracharya's Sanskrit Ganita Sarasangraha into Telugu. Rajaraja Narendra honoured him with the agrahara Navakhandavada.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: The practice of Satavahana kings prefixing their personal names with mother names started during whose period?
x: The tradition of kings adding their mother's name began with Gautamiputra Satakarni, son of Gautami Balashri. It is attributed to polygamy.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Which inscription describing the military victories of Gautamiputra Satakarni?
x: The Nasik Prashasti, issued by Gautami Balasri in the 19th regnal year of Pulomavi-II, is the main source on Gautamiputra Satakarni.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Ramachandralayam in Hampi popularly called as?
x: The Hazara Rama temple in Hampi was built by Srikrishna Devaraya.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Commentaries on the Vedas were written under the leadership of Sayana and Madhava during whose period?
x: Commentaries on the Vedas were composed under Sayana and Madhava during the reign of Harihara-II. Sayana also wrote Vedartha Prakasika and Madhava Parasaramadhaviyam.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: The English East India Trading Association established a factory in the town of Machilipatnam. But who allowed the company to do that?
x: The British set up their first trading post at Machilipatnam in 1611 with the permission of Golconda Sultan Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah. It was their first settlement in South India and on the East Coast.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: During the rebellion of 1857 an attempt was made to incite rebellion in a town in Rayalaseema. What is that town?
x: Sheikh Peer Saheb declared Jihad against the British in Kadapa during the 1857 rebellion. The unrest ended with his arrest.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Who among the following played a leading role in the anti-zamindari struggle in Nellore district?
x: In 1930 Vennelakanti Raghavaiah and Nellore Venkataramanaidu founded the Nellore District Zamin Rythu Sangam. The Venkatagiri zamindari movement started with its efforts.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: In which year Zillabandi system was introduced in Hyderabad state?
x: The Zillabandi system was introduced in Hyderabad state in 1865.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Who preached the "Sadvada" philosophical tradition?
x: The Jain Kundakundacharya preached the Syadvada philosophical tradition.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Who among the following is recognized as the founder of Satavahana administration?
x: Simukha (Srimukha) founded Satavahana rule. Gautamiputra Satakarni was the greatest Satavahana and Pulomavi-III the last.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Where was the English Fort St. George built?
x: Francis Day, a British officer at Machilipatnam, built Fort St. George at Madras in 1639-40 under the orders of the Surat Council.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Where did Acharya N.G. Ranga establish the first kisan school?
x: In 1934 N.G. Ranga established the Bharatiya Raithu Sikshana Kendram at Nidubrolu, Guntur district.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p13
s: Justice Party was formed to target whose interests?
x: The Justice Party was formed in 1917 against Brahmin dominance in politics, education and jobs. Its founders were Thyagaraya Chetty, C.N. Mudaliar and T.M. Nair.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Which of the following is not correct in the context of the socio, economic and religious conditions of the Satavahanas?
o: Although the Satavahana kings followed Hinduism, some of their queens did not. Buddhism was nurtured
x: Women had a respectable position in Satavahana society, enjoyed religious freedom and took part in royal affairs (e.g. Naganika, Gautami Balashri). So statement 3 is false.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: On which day did Kandukuri Veereshalingam perform the first widow remarriage?
x: Veeresalingam performed the first widow remarriage in Andhra on December 11, 1881 for Gogulapati Sriramulu and Seethamma. The second was on December 15, 1881.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s:
Match the following?
A. Veera Telangana
B. Nenu-Nadesham
C. Veyyipadagalu
D. Andhrula sanghika charitra
i. Vishwanatha Satyanarayana
ii. Suravaram Prathapa Reddy
iii. Darshi Chenchaiah
iv. Ravi Narayana Reddy
x: Veera Telangana - Ravi Narayana Reddy; Nenu-Naadesham - Darsi Chenchaiah; Veyyi Padagalu - Viswanatha Satyanarayana; Andhrula Sanghika Charitra - Suravaram Prathapa Reddy.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Identify the scholar who argued that Satavahanas were not Andhras and "Andhrabhrutyas" were?
x: V.N. Sukthankar proposed that the Andhras and Satavahanas were not the same and called the Satavahanas Andhrabhrityas. V.A. Smith and R.G. Bhandarkar held that the Satavahanas were Andhras.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: In which year the battle of Padmanabha took place?
x: On 10 July 1794 the British killed Chinna Vijayaramaraju of Vizianagaram in battle at Padmanabham, after he rebelled against orders removing him from the zamindari.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Where was Raitwari system first introduced in Madras Presidency?
x: Thomas Munro, assisting Captain Read in Baramahal (1792-99), first introduced the system there, which later came to be known as the Ryotwari system.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Who among the following collected Vemana poems?
x: C.P. Brown collected Vemana's poems and translated them into English. He called Telugu the 'Italian of the East'.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Who among the following kings built Rajahmundry?
x: Rajahmundry city was built by Ammaraja-I (927 AD).

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s:
Arrange the following dynasties that ruled Andhra region in chronological order based on the year of their reign?
a. Ikshvakus
b. Vishnukundinas
c. Shalankayanas
d. Brihatpalayanas
x: Chronological order: Ikshvakus > Brihatpalayanas > Salankayanas > Vishnukundins.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Gathasaptasati was written by?
x: Hala wrote the Gathasaptasati in Prakrit.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Bipin Chandrapal visited the districts of Andhra during the Vande Mataram movement. Whose guest was he staying in Machilipatnam?
x: Ramadasu Naidu arranged Bipin Chandra Pal's stay in Machilipatnam during his Vande Mataram tour of Andhra.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Nizam College was established in Hyderabad in which year?
x: Nizam College was established in 1887 during the reign of the sixth Asaf Jahi Nizam, Mahbub Ali Khan.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: Where was the High Court established when Andhra State was formed?
x: A High Court was established at Guntur on July 4, 1954 after Andhra State was formed.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p14
s: During the rule of the Satavahanas, which administration was carried out by the Nigama Sabhas?
x: Nigamas were towns; their civic affairs were managed by assemblies called Nigama Sabhas, whose members were Gahapatis. The Bhattiprolu inscription and Gathasaptasati mention them.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: What does the Chanda Railway Scheme agitation in Hyderabad state represent?
o: Beginning of public consciousness in the state
x: After the Secunderabad-Wadi line (1874), people became aware of the exploitation of Singareni coal; the Chanda railway scheme agitation of 1883 marked the beginning of public consciousness.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: The founder of Srikrishna Devaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam?
x: Komarraju Lakshmana Rao founded the Sri Krishna Devaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam at the residence of Ravichettu Ranga Rao with the help of the Raja of Munagala and others.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Who was the last Chief Minister of Andhra State?
x: Bejawada Gopala Reddy was the second and last Chief Minister of Andhra State. Tanguturi Prakasam was the first.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: What was the official language of the Eastern Chalukyas?
x: The official language of the Eastern Chalukyas was Sanskrit, as of the Vishnukundins, Kakatiyas and Reddy kings. Satavahanas and Ikshvakus used Prakrit.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Which of the following was the capital of Ikshvaku?
x: The Ikshvaku capital was Vijayapuri.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Who founded the journal Satihita Bodhini?
x: Kandukuri Veeresalingam founded the magazine Satihita Bodhini in 1883 for the upliftment of women.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: An agreement called Gentlemen's Agreement was signed before the formation of Andhra Pradesh. How many leaders signed it?
x: Leaders of Andhra and Telangana met in Delhi on February 20, 1956 and reached the Gentlemen's Agreement. A total of 8 members (4 from each region) participated.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: In which year was the Treaty of Sribagh signed?
x: The Sri Bagh Pact was made on November 16, 1937 at Kasinadhuni Nageswara Rao's residence 'Sri Bagh' in Madras to protect the interests of Rayalaseema.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Osmania University was established in which year?
x: Osmania University was established in 1918 by Mir Osman Ali Khan, the 7th Nizam of Hyderabad.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Where was the headquarters of Andhra University when it was first established?
x: Andhra University started at Vijayawada on April 28, 1926 with C.R. Reddy as first vice-chancellor. It was later shifted to Waltair (Visakhapatnam).

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: In Andhra Pradesh the Congress rule which continued unbroken since 1956 was interrupted by the emergence of a new political party. What year did that happen?
x: The Telugu Desam Party, founded on March 29, 1982, won the Assembly elections held on January 5, 1983. N.T. Rama Rao took oath on January 9, 1983.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Where was the first meeting of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha formed in 1934?
x: The first meeting of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha was held on January 28, 1934 in Madras under the chairmanship of Nemali Pattabhirama Rao of Kadapa.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: In which year did Ittehad-ul-Muslimeen emerge in Hyderabad state?
x: Ittehad-ul-Muslimeen emerged in Hyderabad State in 1927.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Who was the first secretary of the Andhra wing of the Socialist Party?
x: The Andhra Socialist Party was formed in Vijayawada on 28 June 1934 with Madduri Annapurnaiah as first secretary and N.G. Ranga as first president.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: Amaravati stupa was built during whose reign?
x: The Amaravati stupa was built during the reign of the Satavahana Pulomavi-II, who took the title Navanagara Swami.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: On which day did the Hyderabad government sign a status quo agreement with the Indian Union government?
x: The Nizam Osman Ali Khan concluded the Standstill Agreement with India on November 29, 1947.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p15
s: In Andhra who was appointed as Dictator of Civil disobedience movement?
x: Konda Venkatappayya was appointed dictator in Andhra during the Civil Disobedience Movement. Salt Satyagraha in Andhra first started at Machilipatnam.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: Who wrote History of Telangana Armed Struggle?
x: Devulapalli Ramanuja Rao wrote 'History of Telangana Armed Struggle'.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: Where is the Parasurameshwara Temple which is considered to be the oldest Shiva temple?
x: The Parasurameswara temple with the oldest Shiva Linga is at Gudimallam in Yerpedu mandal, Chittoor district.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: On which day did Potti Sri Ramulu start his fast to death for the formation of Andhra State?
x: Potti Sriramulu began his hunger strike on October 19, 1952 at Bulusu Sambamurthy's house in Madras and died on December 15, 1952 after 58 days.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: During which movement did Tanguturi gain the title of "Andhrakesari" by showing his bravery?
x: During the Simon Go Back protest in Madras (1928), Tanguturi Prakasam bared his chest before police guns, daring them to shoot, and earned the title Andhra Kesari.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: Identify the first president of Hyderabad State Congress among the following?
x: Govinda Rao Nanal was the first President of the Hyderabad State Congress.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: When did the Vande Mataram movement take place in Osmania University?
x: The Vande Mataram movement took place in Osmania University in 1938.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: In 1932, a committee was appointed by the Nizam of Hyderabad under the chairmanship of Aravamudu Iyengar. The committee was especially formed to suggest reforms in which sector?
x: The Aravamudu Iyengar committee was appointed by the Nizam in 1932 to suggest political reforms.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: In which year Communist Party was banned in Hyderabad state?
x: The Communist Party was banned in Hyderabad state in 1946.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: First book published in Telugu?
x: Benjamin Schultz's Bible was the first book published in Telugu.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: Which Indian state was the first to sign the Subsidiary alliance with the East India Company?
x: On 1 September 1798, Nizam Ali Khan (Asaf Jah-II) of Hyderabad was the first to sign a Subsidiary Alliance with the English East India Company.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: P. Anandacharya, the first Andhra to preside over the Indian National Congress, became the Congress President in which year?
x: P. Anandacharyulu was the first Andhra to preside over the Indian National Congress, at its Nagpur session (1891).

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: Who wrote the book "At the Feet of the Master"?
x: 'At the Feet of the Master' was written by Jiddu Krishnamurti when he was 14 years old.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: Which of the following is incorrect about Damodaram Sanjeevaiah?
o: He was never defeated in an election
He was the second Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh
He served as the President of the Indian National Congress
Worked as a minister in Andhra Pradesh government
x: Damodaram Sanjeevaiah was the second Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1960-62) and the first Dalit Chief Minister in the country.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p16
s: In which year was National College established in Machilipatnam?
x: During Bipin Chandra Pal's visit to Machilipatnam in 1907, the foundation of the National College was laid with Kopalle Hanumantha Rao as principal. It started on 27 March 1910 as Bandar National College.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p17
s: Which of the following is the first novel in Telugu?
x: Rajasekhara Charitra (by Kandukuri Veeresalingam) was the first novel in Telugu. It was based on Oliver Goldsmith's 'Vicar of Wakefield'.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of AP and General Overview of the Indian Constitution
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p17
s: "Maha Prasthanam" was authored by?
x: Maha Prasthanam is the lyric poetry of Srirangam Srinivasa Rao (Sri Sri).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Who among the following dynasties founded the Kingdom of Birar?
x: Birar was ruled by the Imad Shahis, Bidar by the Barid Shahis, Bijapur by the Adil Shahis, Ahmednagar by the Nizam Shahis and Golconda by the Qutb Shahis.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: What was the headquarter of the Dutch East India Company's locations in India?
x: The main base of the Dutch East India Company in India was Nagapatnam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Sangama was the father of Harihara Bukkaraya, the founder of Vijayanagara Empire and ______?
o: A king of Vengi Chalukya descent
x: Sangama, the founder of the Sangama dynasty, was a Yadava king. Harihara and Bukka, founders of Vijayanagara, were his sons.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: To whom were the Kakatiyas feudatories before taking over the kingdom?
x: The Kakatiyas were originally feudatories of the Rashtrakutas (Garuda symbol) and later of the Kalyani Chalukyas (Varaha symbol). The Magallu inscription mentions Gundaya Rashtrakuta as the first historical Kakatiya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Which of the following round table meetings held in London was attended by famous national writers Sarojini Naidu and Muhammad Iqbal?
o: First and Second Round Table Conference
x: Sarojini Naidu and Muhammad Iqbal participated in the Second Round Table Conference held in London (September-December 1931).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Where is the C.P. Brown Memorial Trust Library in Andhra Pradesh?
x: In recognition of C.P. Brown's contribution to Telugu literature, a library building was constructed at his residence in Kadapa.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Who is called a DESHA BANDHU?
x: Chittaranjan Das bore the title Deshabandhu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Who was the first Dalit Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Damodaram Sanjivaiah was the first Dalit Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh and of India, serving from 11 January 1960 to 12 March 1962.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Who came to power in Magadha after the Mauryas?
x: Pushyamitra Sunga defeated Brihadratha, the last Maurya king of Magadha, and founded the Sunga dynasty.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Who is known to have come south along with Chandragupta Maurya when there was a famine in North India?
x: During a severe famine in Magadha under Chandragupta Maurya, Jain monks led by Bhadrabahu migrated to Sravanabelagola near Mysore. Those who stayed under Sthulabhadra became Svetambaras.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p26
s: Which of the following pair is incorrectly matched?
x: Option 2 is wrongly matched: Buddhacharita is not Nagarjuna's work. Hala - Gathasaptasati, Vatsyayana - Kamasutra and Gunadhya - Brihatkatha are correct.
